proof:
subst h₁
subst h₀
rcases Nat.eq_of_digits h₂ with ⟨a, b, hb, hn⟩
subst hn
simp only [Nat.digits_def', Nat.ofDigits_digits, Nat.ofDigits_singleton, List.length_cons,
  List.length_singleton] at h₂
have ha : a < 10 := by omega
have hs :
    (Nat.digits 10 (a + 10 * b)).sum = a + b := by
  rw [show a + 10 * b = Nat.ofDigits 10 [a, b] by simp [Nat.ofDigits]]
  rw [Nat.digits_ofDigits]
  · simp
  · decide
  · simp [hb]
  · simp [ha]
have hp :
    (Nat.digits 10 (a + 10 * b)).prod = a * b := by
  rw [show a + 10 * b = Nat.ofDigits 10 [a, b] by simp [Nat.ofDigits]]
  rw [Nat.digits_ofDigits]
  · simp
  · decide
  · simp [hb]
  · simp [ha]
rw [hs, hp] at h₃
have hEq : a + 10 * b = a * b + (a + b) := h₃
have hbne : b ≠ 0 := by
  omega
have hfac : (a - 1) * (b - 1) = 9 := by
  omega
have hapos : 1 ≤ a := by
  by_cases h : a = 0
  · subst h
    omega
  · omega
have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := by
  by_cases h : b = 0
  · exact (hbne h).elim
  · omega
have hcases : (a = 2 ∧ b = 10) ∨ (a = 4 ∧ b = 4) ∨ (a = 10 ∧ b = 2) := by
  have hdiv : a - 1 = 1 ∨ a - 1 = 3 ∨ a - 1 = 9 := by
    nlinarith [Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega : a - 1 ≠ 0), hfac]
  rcases hdiv with h1 | h3 | h9
  · left
    omega
  · right
    left
    omega
  · right
    right
    omega
rcases hcases with h | h | h
· rcases h with ⟨ha2, hb10⟩
  omega
· rcases h with ⟨ha4, hb4⟩
  omega
· rcases h with ⟨ha10, hb2⟩
  omega

have hfac : 1296 = 2 ^ 4 * 3 ^ 4 := by norm_num
rw [hfac] at h₀
have hxle : x ≤ 4 := by
  by_contra h
  have hxge : 5 ≤ x := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have h2x : 2 ^ 5 ≤ 2 ^ x := by
    exact pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hxge
  have hmul : 2 ^ 5 * 3 ^ y ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h2x
  have h35 : 3 ^ y ≥ 3 := by
    have : 1 ≤ y := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hy
    calc
      3 = 3 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 3 ^ y := by
        exact pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) this
  have hbig : 96 ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := by
    calc
      96 = 2 ^ 5 * 3 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ 5 * 3 ^ y := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h35
      _ ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := hmul
  have : 1296 < 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := by
    calc
      1296 < 96 * 27 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 96 * (3 ^ y) := by
        have h27 : 27 ≤ 3 ^ y := by
          have : 3 ≤ y := by omega
          calc
            27 = 3 ^ 3 := by norm_num
            _ ≤ 3 ^ y := by
              exact pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) this
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h27
      _ ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := by
        exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h35) hbig
  omega
have hyle : y ≤ 4 := by
  by_contra h
  have hyge : 5 ≤ y := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have h3y : 3 ^ 5 ≤ 3 ^ y := by
    exact pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hyge
  have hmul : 2 ^ x * 3 ^ 5 ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h3y
  have h2x : 2 ^ x ≥ 2 := by
    have : 1 ≤ x := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hx
    calc
      2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ x := by
        exact pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) this
  have hbig : 486 ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := by
    calc
      486 = 2 * 3 ^ 5 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ 5 := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h2x
      _ ≤ 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := hmul
  have : 1296 < 2 ^ x * 3 ^ y := by
    calc
